question: A short, interesting or amusing story about a real person or event

question: The study of history through the analysis of artifacts

question: A person who has had one or more limbs removed
solution: An amputee is a person who has lost a hand or leg through surgery (अपंग व्यक्ति).

question: A person who selflessly works for the welfare of others
solution: An altruist is someone who cares about other people's needs more than their own. परोपकारी व्यक्ति।

solution: An advocate supports a policy or speaks for someone else in court (समर्थक या वकील).

solution: The museum has a collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts. मानव द्वारा बनाई गई पुरानी और महत्वपूर्ण वस्तु।

solution: Ablution means the act of washing your body, specifically as a religious ceremony. धार्मिक अनुष्ठान के रूप में किया गया शुद्धि-स्नान।

question: Causing shock or dismay

solution: The bank conducted an appraisal of the house. किसी चीज़ की कीमत या मूल्य का आकलन।

solution: Astrology is not considered a hard science. भविष्य बताने वाली विद्या (ज्योतिष शास्त्र)।

solution: The sound of the waves was clearly audible. जो आसानी से सुनाई दे सके।

question: Deviation from the right course or what is normal
solution: Aberration means a departure from what is normal or expected. जब कोई व्यक्ति अपने सही रास्ते या सामान्य व्यवहार से भटक (deviate) जाता है।

question: To renounce or give up a right or belief
solution: Abnegate means to reject or renounce something. अपने अधिकार या किसी विश्वास को त्याग देना।

question: Strict and plain in manner or lifestyle
solution: The monks followed an austere way of life. जो बहुत सीधा-सादा और सख्त हो (आडंबरहीन)।

solution: Frogs and toads are amphibians because they live in both water and land (उभयचर).

solution: An altimeter measures how high an aircraft is from the ground (ऊँचाई मापने का यंत्र).

solution: South Africa was famous for its policy of apartheid. रंग या जाति के आधार पर किया जाने वाला भेदभाव।

question: A place of refuge; an institution for the mentally ill
solution: The refugees sought political asylum in the neighboring country. शरणस्थल या मानसिक रोगियों का चिकित्सालय।

question: A person who is unable to stop using a harmful substance
solution: An addict is someone who is dependent on a drug or habit (नशेड़ी).

question: Extreme mental or physical suffering
solution: Agony is severe physical or mental pain. अत्यधिक पीड़ा (suffering).

question: Greatly surprised or amazed
solution: I was astonished to hear the news of his success. किसी बात पर बहुत अधिक हैरान या अचंभित होना।

solution: An accident is an unpleasant event that happens unexpectedly (दुर्घटना).

solution: Alpinism is the activity of climbing mountains like the Alps (पर्वतारोहण).

solution: 'Thee' and 'Thou' are archaic words in English. बहुत पुराना या जो अब चलन में न हो।

question: In a friendly and peaceable manner
solution: Amicably is the adverb form. किसी विवाद को शांतिपूर्ण और दोस्ताना (friendly) तरीके से सुलझाना।

question: Readily willing to be guided or controlled
solution: An amenable person is easy to persuade or control. जो सलाह मानने या निर्देश का पालन करने को तैयार (willing) हो।

question: To go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere
solution: Abscond means to run away secretly. जब कोई अपराधी पकड़े जाने के डर से चुपके से फरार (escape) हो जाता है।

solution: An accountant is someone who manages financial accounts (मुनीम या लेखपाल).

question: The height of an object or point above sea level
solution: Altitude is the vertical distance of something above the sea level (ऊँचाई).

question: A person trained to travel in a spacecraft

question: The character and atmosphere of a place
solution: Ambience is the feeling or mood of a particular place (वातावरण या माहौल).

question: With suspicion, doubt, or disapproval

question: Former students of a school, college or university
solution: Alumni is the plural form for former students (भूतपूर्व छात्र).

solution: Alimony is the legal obligation to provide financial support to a spouse after separation (गुजारा भत्ता).

question: The act of giving up the throne or authority
solution: Abdication is the noun form of abdicate. यह सत्ता या पद त्यागने की प्रक्रिया (act) है।

question: A mass of snow falling rapidly down a mountainside
solution: An avalanche destroyed several houses in the valley. पहाड़ से तेज़ी से गिरता हुआ बर्फ का ढेर।

question: A place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict
solution: The political arena is full of challenges. अखाड़ा या वह स्थान जहाँ कोई विशेष गतिविधि होती है।

question: Keen interest or enthusiasm

solution: An analogy is used to explain something by comparing it to something else. समानता के आधार पर दो चीज़ों के बीच तुलना करना।

question: A person who renounces religious or political beliefs
solution: An apostate is someone who has rejected their former faith. वह व्यक्ति जो अपने धर्म या विश्वास को त्याग चुका हो।

question: A feeling of intense passion or enthusiasm
solution: He spoke with great ardour about his new project. किसी काम के लिए अत्यधिक जोश या उत्साह।

question: Resembling a weak old woman
solution: Anile behavior refers to someone showing the weaknesses of old age. बुढ़िया के समान कमज़ोर या वैसा ही व्यवहार करने वाला।

question: A list of items to be discussed at a meeting
solution: Agenda is a list of matters to be dealt with (कार्यसूची).

question: A person who has both introverted and extroverted qualities
solution: An ambivert is someone whose personality is a balance of introversion and extroversion (अंतर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी गुणों वाला).

question: Loss of ability to understand or express speech
solution: Aphasia is usually caused by a stroke or brain injury. दिमाग में चोट के कारण बोलने या समझने की शक्ति खो देना।

question: The scientific study of sound
solution: Acoustics is the branch of physics that deals with sound (ध्वनि-विज्ञान).

question: An award, honour, or laudatory notice granted as special recognition
solution: Accolade is praise or an award for an achievement. विशेष सम्मान या पुरस्कार।

solution: Anorexia makes people avoid food because they fear gaining weight. वजन बढ़ने के डर से खाना छोड़ने या बहुत कम करने की बीमारी।

question: One who practises severe self-discipline and avoids pleasures
solution: The monks live a very simple, ascetic life. वह व्यक्ति जो भौतिक सुख-सुविधाओं का त्याग कर तपस्या करता है।

question: Using new or unconventional ideas; ahead of its time
solution: His music was considered very avant-garde for the 1960s. समय से आगे की सोच या नए प्रयोगों वाला।

question: One who studies celestial bodies
solution: Astronomers use telescopes to study planets and stars. ग्रहों और नक्षत्रों का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन करने वाला।

question: Extreme greed for wealth or material gain
solution: Avarice can lead people to do dishonest things. धन या संपत्ति का अत्यधिक लालच।

question: Characterized by friendliness and absence of discord
solution: Amicable relates to relations that are friendly and peaceful (मैत्रीपूर्ण).

question: A person who studies or collects antiques
solution: An antiquarian is an expert in old and rare books or objects. प्राचीन वस्तुओं का जानकार या उन्हें इकट्ठा करने वाला।

question: A person who is sent to spread a religious message
solution: The apostles traveled far to spread the word of God. धार्मिक संदेश का प्रचार करने के लिए भेजा गया व्यक्ति।

question: The soil deposited by flowing water
solution: Alluvium is fertile soil left by rivers after a flood (जलोढ़ मिट्टी).

question: To belong to or be connected with something
solution: These documents appertain to the legal case. किसी चीज़ से संबंधित (related) होना।

question: Belonging to the very distant past
solution: Ancient civilizations existed thousands of years ago. बहुत पुराने समय या प्राचीन काल से संबंधित।

question: A blank book for keeping a collection of photographs, stamps, or pictures
solution: An album is used to store and display collections (चित्र संग्रह की किताब).

question: The science of the bodily structure of living organisms
solution: Anatomy is the study of the structure of human or animal bodies. शरीर की बनावट का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन (शरीर रचना विज्ञान)।

question: A person who deliberately sets fire to property
solution: The arsonist was caught on the security camera. वह व्यक्ति जो आगजनी का अपराध करता है।

question: A word opposite in meaning to another word
solution: 'Happy' is the antonym of 'sad'. वह शब्द जिसका अर्थ किसी दूसरे शब्द के विपरीत हो (विलोम)।

solution: Accomplishment means something that has been achieved successfully (उपलब्धि).

question: A diplomatic representative of one's country in another country
solution: An ambassador is a high-ranking official sent to represent their nation (राजदूत).

question: A deviation from what is normal or expected
solution: A cold day in July is a weather anomaly. सामान्य से अलग दिखने वाली कोई चीज़ या अनियमितता।

question: A partial or total loss of memory
solution: Amnesia is a medical condition where someone forgets their past or identity (भूलने की बीमारी).

question: To believe in and follow a rule, belief, or plan
solution: Adhere means to stick to a firm belief or rule. किसी नियम या सिद्धांत का सख्ती से पालन (follow) करना।

question: A person from a foreign country; a fictional being from another world
solution: Alien means someone who does not belong to your group or country. विदेशी या परग्रही (extra-terrestrial).

question: Having an extreme desire for wealth
solution: The avaricious businessman only cared about his profits. वह व्यक्ति जो धन के लिए बहुत लालची हो।

question: Sharp and bitter in speech or temperament
solution: Acerbic means speaking in a direct and rather cruel way. कड़वा स्वभाव या चुभने वाली बात।

question: A substance for killing algae
solution: Algaecide is a chemical used to kill algae (शैवालनाशक).

question: To attribute a cause or characteristic to something
solution: This poem is ascribed to a famous 16th-century writer. किसी चीज़ का श्रेय या कारण किसी को देना।

question: An extremely handsome young man
solution: Adonis originates from Greek mythology and refers to a very good-looking man. बहुत खूबसूरत नौजवान।

question: A narration of past events inserted into the current storyline
solution: Analepsis is like a 'flashback' in a movie or story. वर्तमान कहानी में अतीत (past) की घटना दिखाना।

question: An instrument for measuring electric current
solution: An ammeter is used by electricians to measure current in Amperes (विद्युत धारा मापने वाला यंत्र).

question: A detailed examination of something complex
solution: Analysis helps in understanding the nature or structure of something. किसी जटिल चीज़ की बारीकी से जाँच-पड़ताल करना।

question: To destroy completely
solution: The nuclear bomb can annihilate entire cities. किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह से मिटा देना या विनाश करना।

question: The ability to speak clearly and express ideas effectively
solution: Good articulation is essential for a teacher. स्पष्ट उच्चारण या बोलने की कला।

question: A word or design that retains meaning when rotated or reflected
solution: An ambigram can be read the same way even if you turn it upside down (घुमाने पर भी समान दिखने वाला शब्द).

question: A government by the nobles or the highest social class
solution: In the past, many countries were ruled by the aristocracy. श्रेष्ठ या कुलीन वर्ग के लोगों का शासन।

question: Suitable for growing crops
solution: Arable land is very important for agriculture. खेती के लिए उपयुक्त या उपजाऊ भूमि।

question: Living or growing in or near water
solution: Dolphins are aquatic animals. पानी में रहने या उगने वाले (जलीय)।

question: Able to use both the left and right hands equally well
solution: An ambidextrous person can write or work with both hands perfectly. दोनों हाथों से समान रूप से काम करने वाला।

question: To express regret for something done wrong
solution: You should apologise for your rude behavior. अपनी गलती के लिए माफी माँगना।

question: The right of self-governance
solution: The university has full autonomy to decide its curriculum. खुद का शासन चलाने या निर्णय लेने का अधिकार।

question: An official inspection of financial accounts
solution: Every company must undergo a financial audit each year. पैसों के लेन-देन या खातों की आधिकारिक जाँच।

question: A judgement that a person is not guilty of the crime they were charged with
solution: Acquittal is the noun form of acquit. जब कोर्ट फैसला सुनाता है कि व्यक्ति दोषी नहीं है (दोषमुक्ति)।

question: The head of a monastery
solution: An abbot is the man who is the head of a monastery (मठ का प्रमुख).

question: To speak formally; to deliver a speech
solution: Address (V.) means to give a formal speech. सभा को संबोधित (address) करना।

question: A person who physically attacks another
solution: The victim identified his assailant in the police lineup. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी पर शारीरिक हमला करता है।

question: A person who kills somebody, especially for political reasons
solution: The prime minister's assassin was caught immediately. किसी महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति की हत्या करने वाला (विशेषकर राजनीतिक)।

question: A ruler who has complete power
solution: The king was an autocrat who ignored the needs of his people. वह शासक जिसके पास असीमित शक्तियाँ हों (तानाशाह)।

question: A strong feeling of dislike or aversion
solution: He felt a natural antipathy towards spiders. किसी के प्रति होने वाली गहरी नापसंदगी या घृणा।

question: A story with a hidden moral or symbolic meaning
solution: An allegory is a story where characters represent qualities like 'pity' or 'truth'. छिपे हुए नैतिक अर्थ वाली कथा।

question: Politely firm and confident
solution: Being assertive helps you to stand up for your rights. अपनी बात को आत्मविश्वास और दृढ़ता के साथ कहना।

question: A shortened form of a word or phrase
solution: Abbreviation is a short form of a word. जैसे 'Doctor' के लिए 'Dr.' का उपयोग करना।

question: Having mixed or conflicting feelings about something
solution: Ambivalent means being unable to choose between two opposing feelings. जब आप किसी चीज़ को लेकर दुविधा (conflicting feelings) में हों।

question: The crime of deliberately setting fire to property
solution: The fire at the warehouse was caused by arson. किसी की संपत्ति में जानबूझकर आग लगाने का अपराध।

question: A large hall used for public gatherings or performances
solution: The concert was held in the school auditorium. वह बड़ा कमरा या हॉल जहाँ दर्शक बैठते हैं (सभागार)।

question: The formal forgiveness of a person's sins
solution: Absolution is a formal statement that someone is forgiven for what they have done wrong. धार्मिक रूप से पापमुक्ति या क्षमादान।

question: Existing or living in the air
solution: Aerial relates to things that happen or exist in the air (हवाई).

question: A substance that relieves pain
solution: Analgesic drugs (painkillers) are used to reduce physical pain (दर्दनाशक दवा).

question: The exact opposite
solution: Love is the antithesis of selfishness. किसी चीज़ का बिल्कुल उल्टा या विपरीत रूप।

question: An irrational and intense fear of flying
solution: Aerophobia is the extreme fear of traveling in an aircraft (हवाई यात्रा का डर).

question: One who does not believe in the existence of God
solution: An atheist does not follow any religion. वह व्यक्ति जो ईश्वर को नहीं मानता (नास्तिक)।

question: The ability to make good judgements and take quick decisions
solution: Acumen is the ability to understand and judge things quickly and clearly. कुशाग्र बुद्धि या समझदारी।

question: To expect or look forward to
solution: We anticipate a lot of tourists this summer. भविष्य की किसी घटना का अनुमान लगाना या उसकी आशा करना।

question: A government by one person having absolute power
solution: The country suffered under many years of autocracy. एक व्यक्ति का पूर्ण शासन या तानाशाही।

question: Not following any moral rules and not caring about right or wrong
solution: An amoral person doesn't care about ethics or morality. जिसे नैतिकता (moral rules) की परवाह न हो।

question: A space or room just below the roof of a building
solution: We store all our old furniture in the attic. घर की छत के ठीक नीचे का कमरा (अटारी)।

question: One who practises one of the fine arts
solution: A painter or a musician is called an artist. कला (चित्रकारी, संगीत आदि) का अभ्यास करने वाला व्यक्ति।

question: An extreme fear of open or public places
solution: Agoraphobia is the fear of being in public places where escape might be difficult (खुले स्थानों का डर).

question: A shortened version of a larger work
solution: Abridgement is the short version of a book (संक्षिप्त संस्करण).

question: The school or college in which one has been educated
solution: Alma Mater is the institution where you graduated. वह संस्थान जहाँ से आपने शिक्षा प्राप्त की।

question: An extreme fear of spiders
solution: Even a tiny spider can trigger arachnophobia in some people. मकड़ियों से लगने वाला बहुत अधिक डर।

question: Open to more than one interpretation; not clear
solution: Ambiguous means something that is vague or unclear in meaning. जिसके एक से अधिक अर्थ (interpretation) निकल सकें।

question: A person who formally requests something, especially a job
solution: There were over fifty applicants for the manager's post. वह व्यक्ति जिसने किसी पद के लिए आवेदन (request) किया हो।

question: A person who helps another commit a crime; a partner in crime
solution: An accomplice is a person who helps a criminal (सह-अपराधी). जुर्म में साथ देने वाला साथी।

question: Hostile and ready to attack or quarrel
solution: Aggressive means being ready to argue or fight (आक्रामक).

question: The place where public or historical records are kept
solution: These old maps are kept in the national archives. सरकारी या ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेजों को रखने का स्थान।

question: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
solution: Aesthetic relates to the enjoyment or study of beauty. सुंदरता या सौंदर्य (beauty) संबंधी।

question: The original inhabitant or native of a country
solution: Aborigine is a noun for a person who belongs to the original race of a country. किसी देश का आदिम या मूल निवासी।

question: A place where weapons and military equipment are stored
solution: The army guarded the arsenal carefully. वह स्थान जहाँ हथियार और सैन्य सामान रखा जाता है (शस्त्रागार)।

question: A lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern
solution: The main problem in our city is public apathy. किसी चीज़ के प्रति रुचि या उत्साह की कमी।

question: The study of beauty and art
solution: Aesthetics is the branch of philosophy that deals with the nature of beauty. सौंदर्यशास्त्र।

question: A place where animals are slaughtered for consumption as food
solution: An abattoir is a slaughterhouse. यह वह जगह है जहाँ जानवरों को खाने के लिए काटा (slaughter) जाता है।

question: The operation and flying of aircraft
solution: He wanted to pursue a career in the field of aviation. विमानों के संचालन और उड़ान का विज्ञान।

question: The inability to feel pleasure in normally pleasurable activities
solution: Anhedonia is often a symptom of depression. जीवन की सुखद गतिविधियों में आनंद महसूस न कर पाने की मानसिक स्थिति।

question: A statement accepted as true without proof
solution: It is a mathematical axiom that 1+1=2. ऐसा सिद्धांत जिसे बिना प्रमाण के सच मान लिया जाता है।

question: One who is not sure about God's existence
solution: An agnostic believes that it is not possible to know whether God exists or not. ईश्वर के अस्तित्व पर संदेह करने वाला।

question: A note added to a text to explain or provide additional information
solution: Students often make annotations in the margins of their books. किसी लेख या चित्र की व्याख्या के लिए जोड़ी गई टिप्पणी।

question: A word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of another word
solution: Anagram is formed by changing the order of letters. जैसे: 'Silent' से 'Listen' बनाना।

question: A state of disorder due to absence of government or authority
solution: Anarchy leads to a lawless situation in a country. शासन व्यवस्था की अनुपस्थिति में होने वाली अव्यवस्था या अराजकता।

question: An extreme fear of pain
solution: Algophobia is an intense fear of experiencing pain (दर्द का भय).

question: A collection of literary works by different authors
solution: This anthology includes poems from the 19th century. अलग-अलग लेखकों की रचनाओं का एक साथ संकलन।

question: A word formed from the initial letters of other words and pronounced as a word
solution: An acronym is a word like 'NATO' or 'NASA' जो शब्दों के पहले अक्षरों से बनता है।

question: Something that is genuine; not fake
solution: The museum confirmed that the painting was authentic. जो पूरी तरह से असली और विश्वसनीय हो।

question: To increase the speed
solution: Accelerate means to happen or make something happen faster. किसी वाहन या कार्य की गति (speed) बढ़ाना।

question: A secret or disguised language used by a particular group
solution: Every profession has its own technical argot. चोरों या किसी विशेष समूह की अपनी गुप्त भाषा।

question: An excessive or obsessive attraction towards men
solution: Andromania is a psychological term for extreme obsession with men. पुरुषों के प्रति होने वाला अत्यधिक या पागलपन जैसा आकर्षण।

question: To become less intense or widespread
solution: Abate means to become less strong or severe. जब किसी चीज़ की तीव्रता कम हो जाती है, जैसे तूफ़ान या शोर, तो उसे Abate कहते हैं।

question: To make (something bad or unsatisfactory) better
solution: Ameliorate means to improve a bad situation. किसी खराब स्थिति को बेहतर (better) बनाना।

question: A person who has a strong appreciation for beauty and art
solution: An aesthete is someone who loves and understands beautiful things. सौंदर्य-प्रेमी।

question: The period between the beginning of puberty and adulthood
solution: Adolescence is the time in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult (किशोरावस्था).

question: An extreme fear of water
solution: People with aquaphobia are afraid of swimming or drowning. पानी से लगने वाला अत्यधिक डर।

question: A person who performs difficult gymnastic feats for entertainment
solution: An acrobat is a person who entertains people by doing difficult movements (कलाबाज़).

question: A table or flat surface where offerings are made to a deity
solution: An altar is a holy table in a church or temple (पूजास्थल की वेदी).

question: Relating to the original inhabitants of a place
solution: Aboriginal relates to the people who have lived in a land from the earliest times. किसी जगह के मूल निवासियों (native) से संबंधित।

question: A person appointed by two parties to settle a dispute
solution: The union and the management agreed on an arbitrator. दो पक्षों के बीच झगड़ा सुलझाने वाला निष्पक्ष व्यक्ति (पंच)।

question: Based on chance rather than on reason
solution: The decision was completely arbitrary and unfair. बिना किसी तर्क या योजना के लिया गया मनमाना फैसला।

question: Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern
solution: Many young people are apathetic about politics. जिसे किसी काम में कोई उत्साह या रुचि न हो (उदासीन)।

question: A medicine to counteract the effect of poison
solution: Doctors gave him an antidote after the snake bite. ज़हर के असर को खत्म करने वाली दवा।

question: A set of rooms forming one residence in a building
solution: They live in a small apartment in the city center. रहने के लिए कमरों का एक समूह या फ्लैट।

question: Extremely old-fashioned
solution: My grandfather has some antediluvian ideas about technology. जो बहुत ज़्यादा पुराना या पुराने ढंग का हो।

question: The main opponent or villain in a story
solution: The antagonist tries to stop the hero from achieving his goals. कहानी या नाटक का मुख्य विरोधी पात्र या खलनायक।

question: A person who believes that laws and governments are not necessary
solution: An anarchist wants to abolish all forms of government. वह व्यक्ति जो शासन या कानून को नहीं मानता (अराजकतावादी)।

question: A medical specialist who administers drugs for relieving pain during surgery
solution: An anaesthetist makes you unconscious or numb before an operation (बेहोशी का डॉक्टर).

question: The practice of attributing human qualities to animals or objects
solution: Anthropomorphism is common in cartoons where animals talk. जानवरों या निर्जीव चीज़ों में मानवीय गुणों का आरोपण करना।

question: To agree to a request, an idea, or a suggestion
solution: The committee gave its assent to the new project. किसी प्रस्ताव या विचार पर अपनी सहमति देना।

question: The act of abandoning one's religious or political beliefs
solution: He was accused of apostasy after leaving his church. अपने धर्म या विश्वास का त्याग करने की क्रिया।

question: One who engages in an activity for pleasure rather than as a profession
solution: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby, not for money (शौकिया व्यक्ति).

question: Extremely attractive and lovable
solution: Adorable means inspiring great affection or delight (बेहद प्यारा).

question: One who officially examines financial accounts or records
solution: The auditor found some errors in the tax reports. वह व्यक्ति जो आधिकारिक रूप से खातों की जाँच करता है।

question: To be harmonious or consistent with
solution: Accord means to be in agreement or harmony with something. किसी बात से सहमत (consistent) होना।

question: A substance in blood that neutralises toxins
solution: The body produces antitoxins to fight against infections. खून में पाया जाने वाला वह तत्व जो ज़हर (toxins) के असर को खत्म करता है।

question: An examination of a dead body to determine the cause of death
solution: The police ordered an autopsy to find the cause of death. मौत का कारण जानने के लिए शव की जाँच (पोस्ट-मॉर्टम)।

question: A deep and seemingly bottomless pit or hole
solution: An abyss is a very deep hole that seems to have no bottom. बहुत गहरी खाई।

question: Willing to take risks and try new ideas
solution: An adventurous person is one who loves excitement and danger (साहसिक).

question: To walk slowly and in a relaxed way
solution: Amble means to walk at a slow, easy pace (धीरे-धीरे टहलना).

question: To give up one's authority or throne
solution: Abdicate means to formally give up a position of power. जब कोई राजा स्वेच्छा से अपना सिंहासन (throne) छोड़ देता है।

question: An action of making amends for a wrong or injury
solution: Fasting is seen as a way of atonement in many cultures. अपनी गलती या पाप का पछतावा या प्रायश्चित करना।

question: A fixed sum paid annually
solution: An annuity provides a steady income after retirement. हर साल दी जाने वाली एक निश्चित राशि या वार्षिक भत्ता।

question: A strong dislike or hostility
solution: There is a lot of animosity between the two rival teams. दो पक्षों के बीच गहरी कड़वाहट या शत्रुता।

question: The date on which an event happened in some previous year
solution: We celebrated our tenth wedding anniversary last week. बीते समय की किसी घटना की वार्षिक तारीख (सालगिरह)।

question: A person who writes books
solution: Mark Twain is a very famous American author. किताबों या लेखों का लेखक।

question: A large body of water with many islands
solution: Indonesia is the world's largest archipelago. द्वीपों का समूह या द्वीपसमूह।

question: The repetition of the same initial sound in nearby words
solution: Alliteration is a poetic device (अनुप्रास अलंकार). जैसे: "She sells sea shells".

question: A medieval practice aimed at transforming base metals into gold
solution: Alchemy was an early form of chemistry used to try to turn ordinary metals into gold (पारस विद्या).

question: An annual calendar containing astronomical data and important dates
solution: An almanac provides information about tides, holidays, and stars (पंचांग).

question: To shorten a piece of writing without losing the sense
solution: Abridge means to make a book or play shorter. किसी लेख को छोटा करना ताकि उसका मुख्य अर्थ (sense) न बदले।

question: A person who works for an expert to learn a trade
solution: He is an apprentice to a master carpenter. कोई हुनर या काम सीखने वाला नौसिखिया (शिक्षार्थी)।

question: To formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution
solution: Abolish means to officially end a law or system. जैसे भारत में 'Sati Pratha' को Abolish (समाप्त) किया गया था।

question: To decide and state officially in court that somebody is not guilty of a crime
solution: Acquit means to free someone from a criminal charge. अदालत द्वारा किसी को निर्दोष मानकर बरी (free) कर देना।

question: A state of temporary suspension or inactivity
solution: Abeyance is a state of being stopped for a period of time. जब किसी योजना या कानून को कुछ समय के लिए स्थगित (suspend) कर दिया जाता है।

question: To make impure by adding inferior substances
solution: Adulterate means to make food or drink less pure by adding another substance. खाने-पीने की चीज़ों में मिलावट (impure) करना।

question: To increase the importance, position or wealth
solution: Aggrandize means to make someone or something seem more powerful or important (शक्ति या पद में वृद्धि करना).

question: To cancel or do away with a law or agreement
solution: Abrogate means to officially end a legal agreement or law. किसी कानून या औपचारिक समझौते को रद्द (cancel) कर देना।

question: A place where bees are kept
solution: An apiary is a place with many beehives. मधुमक्खियों के पालने का स्थान।

question: A book written by a person about their own life
solution: 'The Story of My Experiments with Truth' is Gandhi's autobiography. किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा स्वयं के जीवन पर लिखी गई किताब।

question: The signature of a famous person
solution: Fans waited outside to get the movie star's autograph. किसी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति के हस्ताक्षर।

question: A written statement confirmed by oath, for use as evidence in court
solution: An affidavit is a legal document used in court (शपथ पत्र). शपथ लेकर दिया गया लिखित बयान।

question: A person who studies human history through excavation
solution: Archaeologists found ancient coins during the dig. खुदाई के जरिए प्राचीन इतिहास का अध्ययन करने वाला विज्ञानी।

question: One who studies the evolution and development of human societies
solution: An anthropologist examines how human cultures have evolved. मानव समाज के विकास और उसकी संस्कृति का अध्ययन करने वाला।

question: A place for keeping birds
solution: The botanical garden has a large aviary with tropical birds. वह स्थान जहाँ पक्षियों को रखा जाता है (पक्षीघर)।

question: An extreme fear of heights
solution: Acrophobia is the irrational fear of being in high places (ऊँचाई का डर).

question: Wildly unreasonable, illogical or ridiculous
solution: Absurd means something that is completely stupid or logical. जो बात पूरी तरह से बेतुकी (ridiculous) हो।

question: An official pardon granted to a group of people
solution: Amnesty is a general pardon, often for political prisoners (सरकारी क्षमादान).

question: The killing of birds
solution: Avicide is the term used for the intentional destruction of birds. पक्षियों की हत्या करना।

question: A combination of two or more metals mixed together
solution: An alloy is a metal that is made by mixing two or more metals (मिश्रधातु).

question: An obsessive love for flowers
solution: Anthomania makes her spend hours in the botanical garden. फूलों के प्रति होने वाला अत्यधिक लगाव या शौक।

question: A drug that makes the body unable to feel pain
solution: The dentist gave him an anaesthetic before the extraction. वह दवा जो शरीर को सुन्न कर दे ताकि दर्द महसूस न हो (बेहोशी की दवा)।

question: A false or assumed name
solution: The criminal was traveling under an alias. अपनी पहचान छिपाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया गया गलत या दूसरा नाम (उपनाम)।

question: A person who studies or cares for trees
solution: We hired an arborist to check the health of the old oak tree. वह विशेषज्ञ जो पेड़ों की देखरेख और उनका अध्ययन करता है।

question: From the very beginning
solution: The legal agreement was declared void ab initio. इसका अर्थ है किसी कार्य या प्रक्रिया का बिल्कुल शुरू से (very beginning) होना।

question: To collect or form into a mass or group
solution: Dust particles agglomerate to form larger clumps. चीज़ों को एक ढेर या समूह में एकत्रित (collect) करना।

question: A thing or an event that exists or comes prior to another
solution: Historical antecedents explain why the current situation is complex. वह घटना या चीज़ जो किसी दूसरी चीज़ से पहले आती है (पूर्ववर्ती)।

question: A person, thing, or idea placed in the wrong time period
solution: A smartphone in a movie about the 18th century is an anachronism. वह वस्तु या विचार जो अपने सही काल या समय के अनुसार न हो।

question: Involving conflict or opposition
solution: The two lawyers had an adversarial relationship in the courtroom. जिसमें विरोध या संघर्ष (opposition) की भावना शामिल हो।

question: A person who is skilled in the use of the bow and arrow
solution: Robin Hood was a legendary archer. वह व्यक्ति जो धनुष-बाण चलाने में निपुण हो (धनुर्धर)।

question: Discrimination based on the alphabetical order of names
solution: Alphabetism in seating charts can be unfair to students with last names starting with 'Z'. नामों के वर्णक्रम (alphabetical order) के आधार पर किया जाने वाला भेदभाव।

question: A person's alternative personality or close, trusted friend
solution: For Batman, Bruce Wayne is his alter ego. किसी व्यक्ति का दूसरा रूप या बहुत ही करीबी मित्र।

question: An ardent follower
solution: The politician arrived with a group of young acolytes. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी विचार या नेता का निष्ठावान अनुयायी (follower) हो।

question: The belief that God does not exist
solution: Atheism is the lack of belief in any deity. यह विश्वास कि भगवान का अस्तित्व नहीं है (नास्तिकता)।

question: Able to live on both land and water
solution: Frogs are amphibious creatures. वह जीव जो जल और थल दोनों पर रहने में सक्षम हो (उभयचर)।

question: A worker skilled in making things by hand
solution: The local market is full of goods made by traditional artisans. वह कुशल कामगार जो हाथ से चीज़ें बनाता है (शिल्पकार)।

question: The highest point in the development of something
solution: Winning the award was the apogee of his career. किसी चीज़ के विकास का चरम या उच्चतम बिंदु।

question: A person who physically or verbally attacks another
solution: The police identified the assaulter from the CCTV footage. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी पर हमला (attack) करता है।

question: The process by which a thing is absorbed into a larger entity
solution: The assimilation of new immigrants into the local culture takes time. किसी चीज़ का बड़े समूह या संस्कृति में समा जाना (आत्मसात)।

question: The surgical removal of a limb or body part
solution: The accident was so severe that it required the amputation of his leg. शरीर के किसी अंग को सर्जरी द्वारा काटकर अलग करने की क्रिया।

question: To test or analyse the content or quality of something
solution: Scientists perform an assay to determine the purity of a gold sample. किसी चीज़ की गुणवत्ता या सामग्री का वैज्ञानिक परीक्षण करना।

question: Related to education
solution: She has a brilliant academic record at school. शिक्षा या अध्ययन (education) से संबंधित।

question: The belief that the existence of God is unknown or cannot be known
solution: Agnosticism suggests that we lack proof of God's existence. वह विचार जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व पर संशय या अनिश्चितता व्यक्त करे।

question: The science or practice of building or flying aircraft
solution: He studied aeronautics to become a pilot. वायुयान बनाने या उड़ाने का विज्ञान (वायुयान विज्ञान)।

question: A person who prepares and sells medicines (old term)
solution: In the 18th century, people went to the apothecary for herbs and pills. दवाइयाँ बनाने या बेचने वाला (फार्मासिस्ट का पुराना नाम)।

question: Willing to take risks or do something shocking
solution: It was an audacious plan to climb the mountain without oxygen. जोखिम उठाने वाला या साहसी व्यवहार।

question: To give a sketchy outline of
solution: The report adumbrated the main points of the new policy. किसी योजना या विचार की संक्षिप्त रूपरेखा (outline) प्रस्तुत करना।

question: A fleet of warships
solution: The Spanish Armada was a famous fleet of ships. युद्धपोतों का एक विशाल बेड़ा।

question: An extreme fear of being alone or isolated
solution: His autophobia makes him feel anxious when he is by himself. अकेले रहने या अलग-थलग पड़ जाने का अत्यधिक डर।

question: Living or often found in trees
solution: Monkeys are arboreal animals. वे जीव जो पेड़ों (trees) पर रहते हैं।

question: Selfless concern for the well-being of others
solution: Mother Teresa was known for her lifelong altruism. दूसरों की भलाई के लिए निस्वार्थ भावना (परोपकार)।

question: The formal stating of charges in a court of law
solution: The suspect's arraignment took place this morning. अदालत में आरोपों की औपचारिक प्रस्तुति।

question: A relic or monument of ancient times
solution: The museum preserves many antiquities from Rome. प्राचीन काल के अवशेष या स्मारक।

question: An imaginary line about which a body rotates
solution: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours. वह काल्पनिक रेखा जिसके चारों ओर कोई पिंड घूमता है (धुरी)।

question: A very long (indefinite) period of time
solution: It felt like an aeon since I last saw her. बहुत लंबा या अनंत समय (indefinite period)।

question: To urge or request someone solemnly
solution: I adjure you to tell the truth in court. किसी व्यक्ति को शपथ दिलाकर या कसम देकर गंभीर निवेदन करना।

question: Relating to or predicting a disaster
solution: The move ended with an apocalyptic battle. प्रलय या भयानक विनाश (disaster) से संबंधित।

question: The settlement of disputes by a neutral party
solution: The labor dispute was settled through arbitration. किसी तीसरे निष्पक्ष पक्ष द्वारा झगड़े का निपटारा (मध्यस्थता)।

question: Honest and straightforward
solution: The deal was completely open and aboveboard. वह व्यवहार जो पूरी तरह से खुला, ईमानदार और स्पष्ट हो।

question: A group of people who listen to or watch a performance
solution: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the play. वे लोग जो किसी भाषण या प्रदर्शन को सुनते या देखते हैं (श्रोता)।

question: Until we meet again
solution: As he left the party, he said, "Au revoir!" अलविदा कहने का एक तरीका जिसका अर्थ है 'फिर मिलेंगे'।

question: A recess in the wall of a room or garden
solution: She placed a reading chair in the quiet alcove. दीवार में बना छोटा अंदरूनी कोना या खांचा।
